text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In addition to her early morning sessions,
Kitasan Black has been
dedicating every
minute of her free time to training.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I can still run! Come on, Trainer, just a little while longer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! See,
I'm fit as a fiddle. I won't
waste even a second of
your time, Trainer!
So let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kita runs off with tremendous speed.
Underneath her hyped-up
attitude, I can
also sense a hint of desperation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I won't waste even a second of your
time,"
huh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe the training program I created
for
her ended up backfiring
and putting
pressure on her instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't want her to feel pressured to
run. I
want her to improve slowly
but surely,
running in the way that best suits her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Tomorrow, you want to go see... the
autumn leaves? Weren't we
going to train?
What happened?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A change of pace...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I get it! You must be exhausted! Right,
that totally makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aw, maaan. I can't believe I didn't notice
until now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I understand! Let's change our pace,
pronto!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Like blam—relaxation! Just leave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to wonder if Kita knows how to
relax. Putting that aside, the
two of us
make plans to go see the autumn leaves
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? That person over there...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, are you okay? You look like
you might be lost...

text_block_list.name: Lost Woman
text_block_list.text: Ah... Th-that's right.

text_block_list.name: Lost Woman
text_block_list.text:
I had my friend draw me a map, but since
I'm not familiar with this
area, it's not
helping me out much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Give me one second. This is the station,
sooo... Ah, this might be a
bit tricky. It's a
little ways away, so I'll—

text_block_list.name: Lost Woman
text_block_list.text: You will? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Hah... Upsy-daisy... Wh-whoa there...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Careful! You're carrying an
awful lot of stuff, mister.

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry for the scare. I thought I'd buy
some gifts for my
grandchildren, but I may
have bitten off more than I can chew...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You want your goods on the luggage rack,
right? Don't worry, I got
this—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I appreciate it. Thank you very
kindly.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so pretty! And so many colors, too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I love that crunchy sound the leaves make
underfoot! Come on,
Trainer, let's go
check out over there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The view from here is amazing! Wait! I see
a dango stand over there!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Do you see it,
Trainer? Right on that hill...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like going to see the autumn leaves
really did make for a nice change of pace.
That said, it's tough at times to keep up
with Kita's
bubbly energy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, you're drenched in sweat... H-how
are you holding up, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're only tired because I dragged you
around today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And before we even got here... You know,
um... I made you help
those people out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since I was already there, it only made
sense for me to help out where
I could.
Not to mention...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that's not the issue! I mean,
I am
super-duper happy to hear
that, though!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I wanted you to rest up more
today, since I'm sure you're
tired from
training me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! You already have plenty, trust me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're not only at all of my training
sessions, but you also keep up
with my
running on your bike!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-that might be true, but I don't want
to... take it for... Mmgh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...What should I do? I'm always...
the only
one being supported...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Sigh... Dad... It's hard supporting someone, isn't it?)
